description: This file defines API functions for managing loan application drafts, including creating, listing, retrieving, patching, checking readiness, submitting, deciding, and deleting drafts via HTTP requests to backend endpoints.

methods.name: toJsonString
methods.description: Converts a value to a JSON string, with fallback for non-serializable values.

methods.name: createDraft
methods.description: Creates a new loan application draft for the authenticated user.

methods.name: listDrafts
methods.description: Retrieves a list of drafts for the authenticated user.

methods.name: getDraft
methods.description: Retrieves a specific draft by its ID.

methods.name: patchDraftSection
methods.description: Patches a section within a draft, updating its data and status.

methods.name: checkDraftReadiness
methods.description: Checks if a draft is ready for submission based on required sections and documents.

methods.name: submitDraft
methods.description: Submits a draft, locking it for further edits.

methods.name: decideDraft
methods.description: Runs risk scoring and decisioning for a draft.

methods.name: deleteDraft
methods.description: Deletes a draft if it has not been submitted.
